description: Land Title Settlement Department - Horetuduwa, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530011
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and legal encumbrances related to specific plots of land in various locations. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it focuses on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
